The structure of Nd2Ti10B20 (reduced formula NdTi5B10) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B centers with 9 geometric neighbors, including 3 B, 1 Nd, and 5 Ti neighbors, while Nd centers have 20 neighbors (12 B and 8 Ti) and Ti centers have 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among B-centered 9-vertex polyhedra and between B and Ti polyhedra, with Ti-centered 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
